1. Zero Network Access · 100% On-Device
BiometricPass requests no internet permission, includes no analytics or ads, and disables cloud auto-backup. Your data never leaves this phone.

2. Hardware-Backed Encryption
All passwords are encrypted using keys protected by your phone's Android Keystore hardware and require biometric or screen lock verification.

3. Transparent Permissions
• Camera: Used only to scan transfer and Backup Key QR codes offline.
• Clipboard Protection: Copied passwords are marked sensitive to hide previews and automatically cleared after 30 seconds.

Your passwords are stored 100% offline on this phone (with zero internet access) and protected by your device\'s security chip.\n\nNo master password to remember—unlock anytime with your fingerprint or screen lock.

① Keyboard Suggestions (Recommended):
Once Autofill is on, tap any login box in an app or browser to see "🔐 Username" and "✨ New Password" chips right above your keyboard.

• Using Chrome? Open Chrome Settings → Autofill services → select "Autofill using another service" and restart Chrome.

② If an app blocks Autofill:
• Long-press the input box → tap "BiometricPass Autofill"
• Or pull down Quick Settings and tap the "BiometricPass" tile to copy & paste (auto-clears in 30s).

① Autofill Popup Menu:
Once Autofill is on, tap any login box in an app or browser to see "🔐 Username" and "✨ New Password" right next to the field.

• Using Chrome? Open Chrome Settings → Autofill services → select "Autofill using another service" and restart Chrome.

② If an app blocks Autofill:
• Pull down the notification shade and tap the "BiometricPass" shortcut
• Or long-press the input box → tap "BiometricPass Autofill" to fill or copy (auto-clears in 30s).
